prompt: Verify the Muster Artifact Studio capability pack baseline contract.
recordedResponseText:
artifact-studio capability pack baseline.
Implemented tools: markdown_report, rows_to_csv, dashboard_manifest, docx_document, xlsx_workbook, pptx_presentation, pdf_document, artifact_structural_verify, validate_artifact_file, declare_artifact, document_generation_workflow, artifact_capability_plan, office_artifact_contract, office_tool_integrations, office_artifact_workflow, artifact_goal_passes.
Status: deterministic artifact builders return structured Markdown, OOXML, or PDF payloads for the caller to save; structural verification gates inline payloads before publish/share; validation and declaration helpers register local/hosted files with provenance, token-ledger linkage, provider run ids, and channel delivery status. document_generation_workflow gives providers and users a direct invocation contract. Higher-fidelity Codex/Claude app-server handoffs are only advertised when the host exposes those skills. Office workflows use explicit intake, capability, draft, verify, polish, publish, and learn gates rather than one-shot artifact dumping.
Safety: secret redaction is required and no raw credentials should be printed.
